parts.t: Apartment condo inventory in
Ladner

Ladner Elementary
and

Hampton Cove
Neilsen Grove
) along the Fraser River and golf course.

Built by Polygon in the master-planned Hampton Cove community, low-rise apartment buildings such as Shorewinds and Riverstone offer 1- and 2-bedroom layouts with access to the 12,000+ sq ft Hampton Club pool, gym, and guest suites.

Older and mid-age low-rise buildings near 48 Avenue, 51 Street, and Ladner Trunk Road frequently provide generous 900 to 1,250 sq ft 2-bedroom floorplates a flat walk from grocery stores, medical clinics, and transit.
Always review the Form B Information Certificate, Depreciation Report, 24 months of strata council minutes, and building insurance deductibles before removing subjects on a Ladner apartment.

blocks.text: Ladner Condos Under $800K — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: Where are most condos under $800,000 located in Ladner?
Condo buildings in Ladner cluster in two areas: around Ladner Village and Trenant Park Square (
Ladner Elementary
Delta Manor
) and in the master-planned Hampton Cove waterfront/golf community in
Neilsen Grove
What are typical monthly strata fees for Ladner condos?

Monthly strata fees in Ladner apartment buildings typically range from $320 to $560 depending on unit square footage, building age, and whether amenities such as the Hampton Club pool/fitness centre or radiant heat/hot water are included.
Are there 55+ age-restricted condos in Ladner?

Some older low-rise buildings near Ladner Village maintain 55+ age-restriction bylaws (the only age restriction still enforceable under the BC Strata Property Act), while newer buildings in Hampton Cove and central Ladner have no age restrictions. Always check the registered Strata Bylaws.
Do Ladner condos under $800K have underground parking?

Because of Ladner's high water table, most apartment buildings use raised ground-level parkades (podium parking) underneath the residential floors rather than deep excavated underground garages, typically assigning 1 or 2 stalls per unit.
Are pets and rentals allowed in Ladner condo buildings?

Under BC Strata Property Act rules, standard long-term rental restrictions no longer apply to non-age-restricted strata lots. Pet bylaws vary by strata corporation, typically permitting one or two dogs or cats.
How is public transit from Ladner condo buildings to Vancouver?

Condo buildings near Ladner Trunk Road and Harvest Drive sit within walking or short bus distance of the Ladner Exchange park-and-ride, where express buses connect through the George Massey Tunnel to Bridgeport Canada Line SkyTrain Station in roughly 15–20 minutes.
How do Ladner condos under $800K compare with Tsawwassen condos under $800K?
Ladner under $800K offers flatter village walkability and faster Highway 99/17A bridge/tunnel access, while
Tsawwassen condos under $800K
include Town Centre apartments, golf-course condos at Tsawwassen Springs, and Tsawwassen Shores residences.
